explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of righteousness, comfort, and judgment over all people.
The divine Son of God who will return to judge the ungodly and give rest to believers.
The power of the Holy Spirit working in the hearts of those who believe, so that they become holy.
People who live without respect for God and reject his laws and will.
God's righteous judgment where he gives each person what they deserve based on their deeds.
Divine punishment or restoration of justice that God exercises over those who persecute his people.
Those who actively do harm to and oppress believers in Christ.
The inner peace, hope, and strength that God's presence gives to those who suffer.
People chosen by God and made holy through faith in Jesus.
Bad or good actions that people perform in their lives.
